# PEAK Game Wiki

> An independent, multilingual, source-aware reference for the Steam co-op climbing game PEAK. The site covers map rotation, biomes, items, badges, achievements, co-op play, troubleshooting, and update context.

## Site Identity

- Canonical site: https://peak-game.wiki/
- Site type: Independent fan reference; not operated by or endorsed by the PEAK developers or publisher.
- Primary audience: Players who need a route check, item context, co-op guidance, achievement help, or version-aware update notes before a climb.
- Current build note: Pages and daily map data are generated at build time. The date shown on a page is the freshness boundary for that snapshot.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://peak-game.wiki/): Daily-map entry point, update desk, item database, progress context, co-op field notes, FAQ, and official source links.
- [Map today and rotation guide](https://peak-game.wiki/map-rotation): Build-time map estimate, reset context, biome vocabulary, route checks, and planning guidance.
- [Items list](https://peak-game.wiki/items/): Searchable catalog of 134 item entries with categories, names, stats or locations where maintained, and source boundaries.
- [Achievements guide](https://peak-game.wiki/achievements): Steam achievement tracking, in-game badge distinction, custom-run checks, and missing-unlock troubleshooting.
- [Badges guide](https://peak-game.wiki/badges-guide/): In-game badge groups, unlock context, route notes, and source-aware progress guidance.
- [Contact](https://peak-game.wiki/contact/): Source-backed correction and feedback route.
- [About](https://peak-game.wiki/about), [Privacy](https://peak-game.wiki/privacy), and [Terms](https://peak-game.wiki/terms): Project scope, data disclosures, independence statement, and accuracy limits.

## Multilingual Routes

The same page set is available in the existing locale routes: English at `/`, Chinese at `/zh/`, Spanish at `/es/`, Japanese at `/ja/`, French at `/fr/`, German at `/de/`, Portuguese at `/pt/`, Korean at `/ko/`, and Italian at `/it/`. The root `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` are the default English machine-readable resources.

## Editorial Boundaries

- Treat official Steam store and Steam news links as the authority for official names, dates, platform statements, update titles, and first-party media.
- Treat practical route, loadout, and troubleshooting advice as editorial field guidance unless a page links a first-party source.
- Do not infer live map results, fixed rotation sequences, exact item effects, prices, platforms, downloads, or achievement conditions when the current source does not verify them.
- Recheck time-sensitive map, patch, item, multiplayer, and achievement details in the current game and official sources after an update.
- Last reviewed for this resource: 2026-10-08.
